purpose: Teach: ウイング/システムズ/サイボウズ/光文社/ウンコ/丸出し/細木/小田急

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがサッカーのウイング、つまりウインガーの動きを教えて下さるわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad taught me about soccer wing play — how wingers move and position themselves.
lines.style: Warm, conversational tone. Gentle smile in the voice. Speaking as if sharing something charming she's learned. Unhurried pacing.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんとIT企業のシステムズの展示会に行ったよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I went to an IT systems expo with Dad. It was so cool.
lines.style: Bright, animated opening. The breathiness of excitement in his words. Quick pace. Eyes-lit-up energy. Eager to share but contained — still a quiet child.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがサイボウズの社内SNSを利用されてるわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad uses Cybozu's internal social network at work. He was explaining how it helps.
lines.style: Warm, musing tone. Speaking gently, as if noticing something thoughtful. Soft cadence. The kind of observation she'd make while listening to him.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと光文社の絵本を読んだよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Dad and I read a Kobunsha picture book together. It was really funny.
lines.style: Earnest, genuine pleasure in his voice. Slight pause before 'really funny' — he's savoring the memory. Quiet delight, not performed joy.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「『ウンコ』って言葉でも面白さに気付くね」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad said something like, 'Even a silly word can be funny when you really listen to it.'
lines.style: Soft, reflective tone. Slight amusement underneath. She's quoting him with affection and a hint of tender humor. Warm cadence, thoughtful pacing.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんに「肌着の腹を丸出しにしちゃダメ」って教えて頂いたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Dad taught me that you shouldn't leave your belly showing when you're wearing an undershirt.
lines.style: Earnest, matter-of-fact delivery. He's relaying a practical lesson with the seriousness of a child taking his father's advice to heart. Steady, clear voice.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「細木数子の占い本は時代を映す」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad was saying how fortune-telling books like Hosoki Kazuko's really reflect the times they were written in.
lines.style: Thoughtful, slightly musing tone. She's reflecting on something he said. Gentle pacing. A bit of wonder in how she's turning it over — the kind of observation you make when you're really listening.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと小田急線で江ノ島に行ったよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Dad took me to Enoshima on the Odakyu train. It was the best.
lines.style: Warm, satisfied close. The contentment of a day well-spent settling into his words. Quiet warmth, no hurry. A small smile at the memory. Trailing-off with gentle finality.
